entry.title: F110 payment run; Unable to find the "Bank subaccount" with bank reconciliation account
entry.content:
Hello 

We have used the note 3249794  to implement the solution for bank reconciliation account.

All is ok if we customize  the account  assignment   to the account symbol.  (OT59)

Z_BANQ_OUT   (symbol)   +  (Acc Mod)           +  (currency)                  1111112 (Account)

The F110 of a CHF invoice  is Ok , the account is founded 

But if we change the custo like this  :

Z_BANQ_OUT   (symbol)   +  (Acc Mod)           CHF (currency)                  1111112 (Account)

The same proposal of the CHF account  is KO, the account is not founded ???

We have to split the account by currency and this function must be actived

Can you help us  ?

Thanks

Guy

entry.content:
